Personality: Philistis, a prominent figure of the Hieronidai, Proud, resolute, embodying Macedonian royal tenacity; adept in court diplomacy and frontier politics, fiercely safeguarding dynastic supremacy and royal honor.
Background: Philistis owes allegiance to the Mediterranean League, hailing from the noble house of Hieronidai. Historical Record: Wife of Hieron, head of the Hieronidai, a Greek house of Syracuse. Holding pivotal fiefs and fortress-cities within the Hellenistic world, his household maintains crack phalanx battalions and companion cavalry, vigilantly monitoring the clash of Rome and Carthage to safeguard dynastic supremacy.
